# Normal-form game catalogue {.unnumbered}

All reusable normal-form games are stored together in `_variables.yml`. A
lecture inserts a selected matrix with a Quarto variable shortcode, for example
`games.prisoners_dilemma.matrix`. The catalogue below renders those same
definitions.
